rules: NO Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines MUST be uppercase + tiny + wide spacing.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with texture.
Hover state color must be explicitly set and lighter than active state.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds under content; always use backdrop blur + opacity.

grid.bento_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
rules: Asymmetry over symmetry. Tension creates interest.
Grid children MUST be direct children. Use display: grid.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate borders to expose the skeleton. Use grid borders for technical sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows in light mode, soft inner glows in dark mode.
surfaces: Glassmorphism (Crystal): backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b border-border (for sticky headers)
Grid Borders: border-collapse style for technical features sections.

motion_and_animations.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Use overflow-hidden wrapper, text translates y from 100% to 0 with spring physics.
motion_and_animations.scroll_reveals: Section elements fade in and translate y (20px) when in view, staggered by 0.1s.
motion_and_animations.hover_effects: Magnetic buttons for primary CTAs. Product cards scale (1.02) with border highlight.
motion_and_animations.marquee: Slow, smooth editorial ribbon (react-fast-marquee or framer-motion) with tech/business keywords.
rules: No transition: all. Use specific transition properties.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: ESCLUSIONE TOTALE: Nessun riferimento a Welfora o Welfora AI in tutta l'applicazione.
LINGUA: Il sito deve essere interamente in italiano.
TECNOLOGIA: Usa React.js (.js o .jsx files, non .tsx). Implementa Lenis per smooth scrolling e Framer Motion per micro-animazioni.
TEMA: Implementa un toggle Dark/Light mode funzionante. Disegna per entrambi.
COMPONENTI: Usa puro HTML/Tailwind per layout di marketing e griglie bento. Usa Shadcn UI (configurato pesantemente) per form, dialogs e tavole comparative.
TESTING: Aggiungi attributi 'data-testid' a tutti gli elementi interattivi e pulsanti.
STILE: Nessun look editoriale-finanziario (no serif, no oro). Solo tech SaaS moderno (sans-serif pulita, badge colorati, ampi spazi bianchi).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner` (no .tsx extension, use .js/.jsx in imports).
